result.instructions: Tools for CharityStack, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which recurring donors cancelled this month?"; "Show the payments for our Year-End Campaign form from the last 30 days."; "Find the contact for jane.doe@example.org and show her lifetime giving.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CharityStack data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run charitystack_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run charitystack_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run charitystack_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. charitystack_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: charitystack_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Read your CharityStack organization name, its website domains and the checkout inputs shared by every form. Use it to confirm the key works. CharityStack API: GET /v1/organization.

tools.name: charitystack_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payment records (one-time gifts and recurring charges), newest first. Page with lastEvaluatedKey. Needs the donations:read permission. CharityStack API: GET /v1/payments.

lastEvaluatedKey.description: lastEvaluatedKey from the previous page's response. Omit on the first page.

tools.name: charitystack_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: Get one payment record with payer, amount, fund, form, status and date. Needs the donations:read permission. CharityStack API: GET /v1/payments/{id}.

tools.name: charitystack_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring donation subscriptions. Filter by status ACTIVE or CANCELLED, or omit it for all. Page with lastEvaluatedKey. Needs the subscriptions:read permission. CharityStack API: GET /v1/subscriptions.

lastEvaluatedKey.description: lastEvaluatedKey from the previous page's response. Omit on the first page.

tools.name: charitystack_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Get one recurring subscription: status, amount, frequency, next and last billing dates, and the fee-cover flag. Needs the subscriptions:read permission. CharityStack API: GET /v1/subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: charitystack_update_subscription
tools.title: Cancel or change a subscription
tools.description: Cancel a recurring subscription (status CANCELLED), reactivate it (ACTIVE), or change its recurring amount in US dollars. Send status, amount, or both. This changes a donor's recurring gift, so confirm with the user first. Needs the subscriptions:write permission. CharityStack API: PUT /v1/subscriptions/{id}.

amount.description: New recurring amount in US dollars.

tools.name: charitystack_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List donor contacts. Filter by email, or page through all contacts with lastEvaluatedKey. Needs the contacts:read permission. CharityStack API: GET /v1/contacts.

email.description: Only contacts with this email address.

lastEvaluatedKey.description: lastEvaluatedKey from the previous page's response. Omit on the first page.

tools.name: charitystack_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact: name, emails, phones, addresses, consent state, lifetime giving totals and subscription flag. Needs the contacts:read permission. CharityStack API: GET /v1/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: charitystack_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Create a donor contact. Returns 409 if an email already belongs to another contact. Defaults: email SUBSCRIBED, SMS NEVER_SUBSCRIBED. Set smsConsent to SUBSCRIBED only with the person's explicit SMS consent. Needs the contacts:write permission. CharityStack API: POST /v1/contacts.

is_primary.description: Mark as the primary email. Exactly one may be primary.

value.description: The phone number. Normalized to E.164; bare national numbers are read as US.

is_primary.description: Mark as the primary phone. Exactly one may be primary.

smsConsent.description: SMS marketing consent. Set only with explicit consent.

tools.name: charitystack_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: Update a donor contact. firstName and lastName are required on every call. emails, phones and addresses are the full desired active list: entries you leave out are soft-deleted, so send the complete list or omit the array to keep it. Needs the contacts:write permission. CharityStack API: PUT /v1/contacts/{id}.

emails.description: The complete desired active email list.

is_primary.description: Mark as the primary email. Exactly one may be primary.

phones.description: The complete desired active phone list.

value.description: The phone number. Normalized to E.164; bare national numbers are read as US.

is_primary.description: Mark as the primary phone. Exactly one may be primary.

addresses.description: The complete desired active address list.

smsConsent.description: A contact who opted out by texting STOP cannot be re-subscribed here (409).

tools.name: charitystack_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List donation and event forms: title, form type, funds, frequencies, goal, active flag and URL. Page with lastEvaluatedKey. Needs the forms:read permission. CharityStack API: GET /v1/forms.

lastEvaluatedKey.description: lastEvaluatedKey from the previous page's response. Omit on the first page.

tools.name: charitystack_get_form
tools.title: Get form
tools.description: Get one donation or event form in full: giving levels, sponsorship groups, tickets, promo codes, custom inputs and FAQs. Needs the forms:read permission. CharityStack API: GET /v1/forms/{id}.

prompts.title: Get started with CharityStack
prompts.description: What you can do with CharityStack here, with example requests to try.
